headline: Raymond James CEO: Capital markets division has 'a lot of upside'
summary: Paul Shoukry, CEO of Raymond James, joins 'Squawk on the Street' to discuss the latest earnings report, the company's growth strategy, the health of the U.S. economy, and more.
